segments.sn33.5:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn33.5:1.3: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti –
segments.sn33.5:1.4: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā … pe …
segments.sn33.5:1.5: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā”ti?
segments.sn33.5:1.6: “Viññāṇe kho, vaccha, aññāṇā, viññāṇasamudaye aññāṇā, viññāṇanirodhe aññāṇā, viññāṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā;
segments.sn33.5:1.8: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā … pe …
segments.sn33.5:1.9: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vāti.
segments.sn33.5:1.10: Ayaṃ kho, vaccha, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti –
segments.sn33.5:1.11: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā … pe …
segments.sn33.5:1.12: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā”ti.
